svg.title: workload-docker workflow modules
svg.desc: ComposeRunner in recorded_compose orders preparation, optional overlays, launch, observation, quiescence, finalization, removal and reporting. Supporting modules supply system-app and Dora steps, event capture, shared Docker operations and explicit crash recovery. Solid arrows show execution order; dashed arrows show module calls. Independent siblings use cooperative async concurrency.
svg.text: workload-docker: workflow modules
All files below are modules in one Rust crate. Paths are relative to src/workflows/.
recorded_compose/mod.rs → ComposeRunner
Orders phases, races execution against stop/failure, retains attempted plans and gates the next run.
Execution: recorded_compose/
Supporting modules / dependencies
preparation.rs · PrepareRun
Validate → prepare system apps → resolve projects concurrently
Capture filesystem baseline; save optional recovery anchor
compose::overlay · PrepareOverlays (optional)
Mount per-run views; substitute execution manifests
projects.rs · LaunchProjects / LaunchDoraFlows
Supporting groups → ordered first-party groups → workloads
Concurrent siblings per group; then start Dora flows concurrently
projects.rs · ObserveProjects
Poll Compose + Dora concurrently until stop or runtime failure
projects.rs · QuiesceProjects
Dora shutdown stages: workloads → producers → recorder drain
Then stop Compose groups in reverse order; concurrent siblings
finalization.rs · FinalizeRun
Verify recordings + collect filesystem changes concurrently
Persist evidence; finalize overlays/write-back; gate removal
projects.rs · RemoveProjects
Remove eligible projects concurrently; verify cleanup
finalization.rs · WriteRunReport
Finish event capture; save post-state, report and admission state
steps.rs + orchestrator::LocalExecutor
Register step factories, shared adapter and diagnostics.
Phase steps invoke child steps through this executor.
Concurrency is explicit join_all / join! on the async task.
system_apps.rs
Generated config; prepare supporting Compose projects.
Probe recording readiness and validate finalized recordings.
dora.rs
Bind, start, inspect and stop configured Dora flows.
CLI runs in owned Compose services; checkpoint flow IDs.
recorded_compose/observation.rs
Before/after host snapshots; Docker event stream.
Runner watches stream failure throughout execution.
compose::* (outside workflows/)
Resolve / start / inspect / quiesce / remove steps
Filesystem baseline + changes; overlay prepare + finalize
DockerAdapter → Compose CLI + Docker Engine
Used by phase steps and the recovery path below.
recovery.rs → compose_lifecycle.rs
Explicit entry points after an interrupted run.
Verify identity → recover Dora → stop → collect → remove.
Checkpoint evidence; reuse it after partial removal.
Direct-mount recovery retains runs needing overlay finalization.
Solid arrows: phase order. Dashed arrows: selected module calls; supporting boxes describe the remaining shared uses.
Stop / startup failure enters quiescence with every attempted plan. Failed evidence or cleanup can retain resources and block admission.
